# Tio Money — concise Copilot instructions

Read [root AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before any edit or review; then the [multi-task index](../.ai/current.md), one assigned task and its persistent [technical discussion](../.ai/discussions/README.md). Verify live branch, PR HEAD, canonical documents and actual code rather than treating summaries or chat as GitHub truth.

- A technical RFC and recorded `PROCEED` decision are mandatory before substantial implementation. **Owner implementation signoff is optional for ordinary bounded work**; restricted security, privacy and financial changes retain their own gates. **Independent review is optional by default**, strongly recommended for ledger, migration, security/privacy, auth and sensitive platform work. Known blockers and configured required checks/reviews remain binding. **Every merge needs explicit owner authorization** naming repository, PR, merge permission and conditions; an agent may perform a permitted non-force merge **only after** verified preflight. This historical policy text itself was never permission to merge PR #2; PR #2 subsequently received separate permission and **merged**. For any new PR, including PR #1 and this cleanup, owner authorization remains a distinct gate; no direct `main` commits.
- Preserve feature ownership, public APIs, pure domain and SQLite adapters, with **one canonical balanced journal**. Future booked money uses validated **native ISO-currency safe-integer minor units**, immutable currency/exponent (INR paise is only the INR case); mixed-currency journal postings stay blocked until [TM-ADR-018](../docs/governance/STAGE-1-FINANCE-ADRS.md#tm-adr-018--native-currency-accounting-and-fx) is settled. **Current UI** has five root destinations, **four blank finance screens and More → Appearance** (persistent System/Light/Dark), one disabled More-aligned Add (no editor), selected tab icon 300/inactive 200, 0dp icon-label gap, 160ms Reduced Motion-aware scene fade. Later owner refinements supersede historic five-blank/1dp/all-200 TM-DEC-005/010 wording. **TM-DEC-011 requires every screen dumb/presentation-only:** controllers own UI state/navigation, domain/use cases own finance math, adapters own persistence; screens only render typed ViewModels and forward callbacks. Transfer principal is not spending, optional transfer fee is; credit cards are liabilities. No unapproved cloud or real automated payment.
- Preserve offline-first behavior, English-only MVP/no language selector, native SMS restrictions in Expo Go and iPhone SMS inbox limitations. No invented Auth, Supabase, cloud backup, encryption, permissions or real-device test claims.
- **Never add any Git `Co-authored-by:` trailer**, including Claude/Opus, Codex, Cursor or ChatGPT. Never spoof the Git author. Record verifiable agent identity only in task/handoff notes.
- When review is performed, inspect changed diff, tested SHA, outstanding prior threads, privacy/security, link/archival/state-gate fixtures and real CI evidence; follow [REVIEW_GUIDE.md](REVIEW_GUIDE.md). Record `PERFORMED / SKIPPED / UNAVAILABLE / DEFERRED` truthfully. A bot `COMMENTED` or quota-limited review is not formal approval; never fabricate tests or permission.
